component.name: Upgrader
component.summary: Configure, schedule and run system-wide upgrades

description.p: A COSMIC Desktop front-end for topgrade. It discovers what topgrade can upgrade on this machine, groups the steps into categories, and lets each one be turned on or off.

Nothing about the step list is built in: the steps, the configuration options and what applies to this system are all read from the installed topgrade, so a newer topgrade brings its new capabilities with it.

ul.li: Every topgrade step, grouped and individually switchable
Skip reasons shown in topgrade's own words
Full configuration editor generated from topgrade's reference
Scheduled checks and optional automatic upgrades
Live progress and a per-step summary
